title: Lights in Motion (2012 aurora borealis time-lapse compilation)
notes: Time-lapse of bright green aurora bands over a mountain/spruce silhouette. The original soundtrack is a separate music composition ('Coronal Mass Ejection' by Peter Van Zandt Lane), so the audio was removed (-an). The cut leaves out the Denali/NPS logo cards at the start and end. Source 1280x720, upscaled to 1080p. Best seconds 0-8 (curling band to bright arc). No people.
fact_en: The aurora occurs year-round, but only in the fall, winter and early spring is there enough darkness at Denali to see the northern lights.
